items.briefing:
Australian CIOs are raising concerns that organisations are rushing to adopt AI faster than their security and governance policies can keep up — a particular risk for training organisations handling sensitive student data. Separately, the booming fintech sector is highlighting gaps where security and financial controls aren't keeping pace with growth, leaving organisations exposed.

If your organisation uses N-able remote monitoring and management (RMM) software, a recently patched vulnerability is now being actively exploited — ensure your IT team has applied the latest updates immediately. **Practical tip:** Check with your IT provider today that all remote management tools are fully patched and up to date.

featured.title: Australian CIOs warn AI ambition outpaces governance
featured.quote: Australian CIOs struggle to govern AI spending as adoption outpaces security controls.
